assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production background panorama for a side-view pixel-art 2D fantasy action game boss arena. Monumental gnarled tree trunks frame extreme left and right, huge ancient broken circular stone shrine behind centre with roots wrapping its arch, distant layered dark teal woodland and subtle shafts of warm gold light through canopy, ferns, moss and old carved stones. Strong depth, rich hand-pixel detail, clean readable combat silhouette area in lower middle. Strict side elevation orthographic, no isometric. A perfectly level continuous horizontal mossy flagstone fighting floor across entire image at exactly72 percent down from the top, with exposed dark root-woven stone foundation visible below it. Foreground terrain detailed, midground darker and less contrast than foreground. Keep bottom-middle floor fully unobstructed for players. No characters, no creatures, no UI, no words, no ladders, no painted floating platforms or steps in combat lane. Match high-quality richly shaded pixel-art desert and dungeon boss arena aesthetic, clear shapes, restrained bloom, NO blur.
